Iya Whiteley, a space psychologist who has worked with NASA, joins Danny Jones for a talk on the minds of astronauts. The episode title asks what crews really see in high orbit. Whiteley studies how space flight strains and changes the people who fly.

Whiteley explains the stress, awe, and strange sights that crews report far above Earth. She also talks about how training tries to keep minds steady on long trips. Jones asks what a trip to Mars would demand of a crew's mental health. Listeners get a rare look at the human side of space flight, told by a pro who trains the flyers.
